headline: Lock-strafe and Item Randomizer 1.0.0 are released
summary: Lock-strafe 1.0.0 and Item Randomizer 1.0.0 are released for installation through the launcher's Mods tab. Lock-strafe provides the Hold and Lock movement schemes moved out of the port. The randomizer shuffles weapons, gadgets, vendor stock, gold bolts and infobot destinations, using seed codes and a logic model to check placements.
highlights: The randomizer's author says each generated placement is checked through its progression logic before use.
A Button Swap Luau example is added, trading selected button pairs and their pressure values before the game reads them.
Native mods move to SDK interface 1.1 and can be installed from the repository's address.
The mods remain GPL-3.0 while their SDK is MIT-licensed.
